{{Quote|Tell your people to take shelter. If you have warriors, now is the time.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Tion Medon]]|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
The '''Utapaun Security Forces''',<ref name="Helmet Collection 25">{{HelmetCollectionCite|25|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> also known as the '''Pau'an military'''<ref name="Force Collection" /> and as the '''Utapaun resistance''' during the [[Invasion of Utapau|Separatist occupation]],<ref name="Tion Medon SWE" /> were a military on the [[planet]] [[Utapau]]. It consisted of [[Pau'an Warrior]]s that acted as [[infantry]]. The [[Pau'an]] military outfitted its [[Soldier|warriors]] with ancient ceremonial [[armor]] and weapons due to the lack of necessary resources to outfit themselves with updated military equipment. Every warrior was well trained with their outdated [[axe]]s and [[Shield (physical armor)|shields]], and were able to utilize them with grievous results when near enemies.<ref name="Force Collection" /> In addition to the vehicles of the [[Utapau Skyforce]], the security force also used [[Dactillion]]s and [[Varactyl]]s as a means of transportation.<ref name="Episode III" />

As the Utapaun resistance to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]'s ongoing occupation,<ref name="Tion Medon SWE" /> the Pau'an military fought alongside the [[Galactic Republic]] against the Confederacy during the [[Battle of Utapau]], but its warriors were [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] after [[Order 66]] was issued.<ref name="Episode III" />
